text: Facing eviction from his Los Angeles ghetto apartment, with a mother who cannot afford cancer treatment, young Fool joins a burglary at the house of [the landlords who call themselves Mommy and Daddy|wants|wealth and ambition] in search of their gold coins. Inside he finds [a pen of pale children in a dungeon-like basement|wrong|harm done to children], punished for breaking the household's see, hear and speak no evil rules, and their abused daughter Alice, who [obeys every rule to survive|rules|break the rule and pay]. Trapped, Fool and Alice flee through [the passageways inside the walls|images|the house and its rooms].
